description.value: White Heather Tea Room is a Victoria institution with over 25 years of service in the Oak Bay neighbourhood, dedicated entirely to the art of traditional British afternoon tea. Cyclists can settle in for an elaborate multi-course experience featuring handmade scones, seasonal finger sandwiches, and rotating desserts, or pick up takeout teaboxes and patisserie items to go. Seasonal themed menus — Valentine's, Easter, Mother's Day — make it a notable destination stop on longer tours of the Saanich Peninsula.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully accessible and confirms an active, well-established afternoon tea room at 1885 Oak Bay Avenue, Victoria, BC. The TAKEOUT section (Teaboxes, Patisserie, shipping) confirms takeout availability, and the menu explicitly notes accommodation of vegetarians, pescatarians, nut-free, and gluten-free diets. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: No phone number present in OSM or visible on the website.
OSM address lacks city and postal code; website confirms Victoria, BC but no postal code is displayed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established 25-year Victoria destination with active dine-in and takeout offerings; suits touring cyclists seeking a notable culinary stop in Oak Bay, especially with gluten-free and vegetarian options confirmed.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu page states 'we try our best to accommodate vegetarians, pescatarians and nut-free diets'; dedicated Gluten-Free Afternoon Tea set offered as a standard menu item

wow_evidence: Victoria institution with over 25 years of service in the Oak Bay neighbourhood
